answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, verified through Intel SGX or AMD SEV remote attestation. A copied key or virtual machine cannot reproduce the authorized measurement and hardware-backed identity; creating another identity therefore requires purchasing and provisioning physical silicon, not duplicating software. Like a ripple crossing a terrace toward an orchard, each accepted node must trace back to genuine hardware.
